checkpoints.description: [1/2] Review the last 72 pushes: remove the dead Python 3.10 TOML fallback from Reforge

impact_assessment.why: 7a13761 raised the floor to Python 3.13, but reforge/textdetect.py still guards tomllib as if Python 3.10 were supported; the fallback is dead and its comments contradict the declared floor the API-age test already applies to reforge/.
impact_assessment.benefits: Reforge imports the standard-library TOML parser unconditionally, and the floor test pins that no production module reclaims 3.10 support.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Reforge TOML review; dependency: stdlib tomllib (3.11+, below the 3.13 floor); concurrency: none; state: reforge/textdetect.py, tests, ADR, map
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first floor test, reforge text tests, full unit tier, root scan, reachability and secret gates
